question.text: The governing body of a stock exchange may waive compliance with membership conditions under Rule 8 of SCRR if a person is considered qualified in respect of:

answer.text: Means, position, integrity, knowledge and experience of business in securities
Net worth and bank balance only

explanation.text: The Logic: Rule 8 permits the governing body to waive admission conditions if the person is considered qualified in respect of means, position, integrity, knowledge, and experience of business in securities. The Trap: Net worth alone is not the test; the waiver requires a holistic assessment that includes integrity, knowledge, and experience. Note: Remember the five-factor waiver checklist: means, position, integrity, knowledge, and experience in the securities business.
